protocol.correction: Add the historical recovery metadata post_shock_observation_hours = observation_end_hour - shock_end_hour before complete field comparison; count physical replay rows when the physical simulation returns and validated rows only after every gate passes. No scientific cohort, objective, input, constraint, threshold or stopping-rule change.
protocol.execution_order: All eight rolling baselines first: six complete frozen-field bridges and two new phase21/full baselines. Release eight offline cases only if every baseline passes. After release attempt all eight even on failure; retain all outcomes.
protocol.prefix_contract: Each offline path replays exactly the paired actual rolling h0..47 actions through original h.simulate. All h48 pre-state fields, including previous_available, thermal, fuel, SOC and debt, continue unchanged. No reset or new initial state.
protocol.physical_domain: Original h._plan constraints on absolute h48..359; original ramp, fuel balances, availability, storage energy/power/efficiencies and every absolute 24h debt deadline. Direct fuel shortages fixed at zero, with full baseline vector inclusion checked before either solve. Only the two global-end SOC bounds become full in full cases; free cases retain original bounds.
protocol.first_objective: Unweighted sum of electricity unserved GWh over h48..359; all other objective entries exactly zero. Save optimal primal/dual certificates and submitted matrices/bounds.
protocol.second_objective: Keep ENS <= first optimum + 1e-6 GWh. Minimize actual remaining-window physical resource cost: fuel burn, nonfossil operation, storage cycling, shifting and net SOC draw, with original direct fuel service and prorated initial-fuel holding as constants. No shortage penalty or carbon-charge term. Check objective plus constants against exported physical account.
protocol.information: Offline LP receives the actual complete remaining 312h input arrays once at h48. It is a model-scoped lower bound conditional on the fixed prefix, rather than an implementable forecast controller. Any gap may reflect information, receding decisions and differing objectives together.
protocol.reporting: All eight conditions, baseline ENS, first-stage lower bound, actual second-stage ENS, signed gap/ratio, primal/dual residuals, cost/CO2/peak/full terminal fuel/SOC/thermal/debt and original recovery windows. No phase selection or new population-success estimate.

original_physical_audit.interpretation: Actions and end states are independently reconstructed; state-accounting verification is not empirical hourly validation.

metrics.stock_holding_assumption: 5 percent/year on committed initial fuel inventory value, prorated by modeled hours; engineering capital charge, not observed storage tariff. Reported separately and not a dispatch decision cost.
metrics.valuation_scope: Declared constant engineering unit values. Fuel arrivals plus initial-minus-terminal stock equal consumption; coal/gas unit values reproduce generation fuel costs. Nonfossil operating costs are separate. SOC draw is charged at a common 0.32 million CNY/GWh. Not observed market prices or national welfare.
metrics.boundary: Single aggregate bus, continuous ramp-constrained plants; no unit commitment, spatial network or empirical hourly calibration. Hydro is an exogenous available-flow bound. Arrivals are domestic/import flows, not unconstrained balancing fuel. Daily flexible-load deadlines and final zero debt; storage terminal state is reported, not forced cyclic.
